faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Antique Vintage Brass & Pewter Keychains?

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Antique Vintage Brass & Pewter Keychains?

faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.
